about_the_game:
Best Selection Vol.1 — a special collection of tracks from the paid DLCs of MASH VP! Re:VISION, now available at an affordable price!

Featuring legendary rhythm-game artists, plus an exclusive bonus track only included in this DLC!

The following songs will be added to “FREEPLAY” mode!

  • GRWM / TORIENA

  • Get Rockin’ / KO3 & Relect

  • Future Logic feat. Jang Mi (VA Vocal) / NAOKI + EmoCosine

《Exclusive Bonus Track for This DLC》

  • Patois Obeah / Roy Mikelate feat. Xeudo Code

  • ICE BLINK / Tatsh

The following mashup tracks will also be added to “MASH UP” mode!

《Exclusive Bonus Track for This DLC》

  • 『星屑の花びら / Tatsh feat. Kiyommy』 × 『ICE BLINK / Tatsh』

※This DLC includes some tracks originally featured in MASH VP! Re:VISION – Bridging to Emotion and MASH VP! Re:VISION – GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03 STARDUST.

Tracks that appear in multiple DLC packs can be played as long as you own any one of the DLCs containing them.

  • 『星屑の花びら / Tatsh feat. Kiyommy』 × 『ICE BLINK / Tatsh』

This mashup track becomes playable when you purchase this DLC.

Please note that while ”星屑の花びら” is included in the DLC MASH VP! Re:VISION – GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03 STARDUST, you must own this DLC in order to play this mashup.

If you only own MASH VP! Re:VISION – GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03 STARDUST, this mashup will not be playable.
